endorsements.name: Hoang Bui
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-7623
endorsements.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in the SMASH-CLP shell. An authenticated attacker with SSH access to the BMC can exploit a stack buffer overflow via a crafted SMASH command, overwrite the return address and registers, and achieve arbitrary code execution on the BMC firmware operating system
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.4)
